title: Albums arranged for Nancy Wilson, Sarah Vaughan, Belafonte and Ella
summary: Willard reads through the album credits for Nancy Wilson, Wes Montgomery, Mel Torme, Sarah Vaughan, Belafonte and Ella, with Jones naming trio members.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: And with record albums, arranging and conducting, for Nancy Wilson on Capitol, we've got, 'Easy,' 'Broadway My Way,' 'Hollywood My Way,' 'The Sounds of Nancy Wilson,' 'Son of a Preacher Man,' and 'Nancy.' And Wes Montgomery, 'Fusion.'
Yes.

Mel Torme, Capitol, 'Raindrops Keep Fallin' On My Head,' and, 'A Time For Us.' Carmen MacRae, on Atlantic, 'The Sound of Silence.' Sarah Vaughan, 'Dreamy,' 'Sarah Vaughan Sings,' and, 'Sarah Vaughan at Mr. Kelly's,' with the Jimmy Jones Trio.
Yeah.
But then you made a lot of 78s with Sarah, didn't you?
Yeah, there were some 78s, but as time went on, -- of course you know we got into the LPs.
Uh-huh.
And it wasn't too long before we got into the LPs, so we didn't do so many 78s, you know.
What label would they have been on?
Music Craft was one. Which, you know, went out of business.
Yeah.
Oh boy, boy, boy. MGM.
Uh-huh. Were you in the ones she did with Billy Eckstine?
Yes. Those were the ones on MGM.

Yeah, MGM, and then there was one LP, a 10 inch LP in a paper jacket on very heavy vinyl material. It wasn't like the -- it must have been one of the earliest LPs. I think it's with Sarah and Billy together, as I remember.
That might be MGM. You know, what they usually do, they re-release them, you know?
Uh-huh.
And we don't know it unless we just happen to browse in a store sometimes and stumble up on them, you know?
Yeah. Then back to albums. Harry Belafonte, 'Jump Up Calypso,' and, 'Midnight Special.'
Yes.
Which was an award winner, you say. What kind of award?

Yes. They called it -- it was done in France. The award -- we got that award from France. Now, it wasn't a jazz thing and it wasn't quite a country and western thing nor was it a calypso album. I don't know what you would call it. It's just a potpourri.
Okay. Then you did Billy Eckstine's Motown album, 'The Love of Ivy.'
Yes.
Is that the one he had the Ellington medley on?
No, he didn't have an Ellington medley on this one.
Ella Fitzgerald and Duke Ellington, on Verve, 'Ella at Duke's Place,' and, 'Ella and Duke at the Cote d'Azur.'
Yes.
With the Jimmy Jones Trio.
Yeah. But 'At Duke's Place,' I did quite a bit of writing.
Uh-huh. Yeah, I remember that. The Jimmy Jones Trio on the Sarah Vaughan album at Mr. Kelly's, who were the members of your trio?
Richard Davis and Roy Haynes.
Uh-huh. And with Ella and Duke at the Cote d'Azur, Jimmy Jones Trio was whom?
Grady Tate and Jim Hugart (PHONETIC).
